context: Evaluates correct usage of the Vendure API's getProduct operation, focusing on initializing getCommerceApi, calling getProduct with a slug variable, and verifying the complex normalization of variants (option groups mapped by groupId), price (divided by 100 from first variant), and images (from assets array).

checklist.name: Use getCommerceApi
checklist.description: The solution calls `getCommerceApi()` from `@vercel/commerce-vendure` to obtain the API instance, rather than constructing a fetcher manually.

checklist.name: getProduct with slug variable
checklist.description: The `getProduct` operation is called with `{ variables: { slug } }` where slug is a string, matching the operation's expected input.

checklist.name: Option group name lookup
checklist.description: The solution correctly expects `displayName` on each variant option to be the option group name found by matching `groupId` to `optionGroups[].id`.

checklist.name: MultipleChoiceOption __typename
checklist.description: Each variant option in the normalized product has `__typename: 'MultipleChoiceOption'`, as required by the commerce framework's variant selection logic.

checklist.name: Price from first variant / 100
checklist.description: The product's `price.value` equals `variants[0].priceWithTax / 100`, not the raw integer value.
